subject: CPPB Domain III: Sourcing & Supplier Selection

questions.q: The strict deadline for an IFB is published as 2:00:00 PM local time. A vendor hands their physical bid package to the procurement receptionist at 2:02 PM, claiming there was heavy traffic. According to standard procurement law, the buyer must:
options: Accept the bid because traffic is a valid excuse
Reject the bid as late and return it unopened to the vendor
Open the bid but add a $500 penalty to the price
Delay the opening for all other vendors by 5 minutes
questions.explain: In competitive sealed bidding, the time deadline is absolute. Bids received after the exact time must be rejected as late and returned unopened to preserve the integrity of the competitive process.
questions.subject: CPPB Domain III: Sourcing & Supplier Selection

questions.q: Under which highly specific exception might a 'late' physical bid occasionally be accepted in some jurisdictions?
options: If the vendor's CEO personally delivered it
If the delay was solely caused by the agency's own mishandling of the package after it arrived on time at the agency's mailroom
If the vendor's price is extremely low
If the courier company experienced a mechanical failure
questions.explain: While late bids are strictly rejected, many jurisdictions allow an exception only if the bidder can irrefutably prove the bid arrived at the government facility on time, but was delayed reaching the bid room solely due to government staff error.
questions.subject: CPPB Domain III: Sourcing & Supplier Selection

questions.q: Before the public bid opening, what is the critical responsibility of the procurement officer regarding received physical or electronic sealed bids?
options: To pre-read the bids and verify the math
To keep the bids securely locked, sealed, and confidential to prevent premature disclosure of pricing
To send a summary of prices to the requesting department
To ask the vendors if they want to lower their prices
questions.explain: Maintaining the integrity of the sealed process is paramount. Bids must remain absolutely secured and unread until the exact moment of the public bid opening to prevent leaks or tampering.
questions.subject: CPPB Domain III: Sourcing & Supplier Selection

questions.q: A massive winter storm shuts down government operations and mail delivery on the day an IFB is scheduled to close. Under standard procedures, what happens to the bid opening?
options: The bids are considered cancelled and the process starts over in the spring
The bid deadline is automatically pushed to the same time on the next official government business day the office is open
The procurement director opens them at home via email
Vendors must navigate the storm to deliver it on time or face rejection
questions.explain: If a government facility is officially closed due to an emergency or inclement weather on a bid due date, statutes and policies universally extend the deadline to the next official business day at the original stated time.
